strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Patch apply recovery can be safely routed later because the recovery task/proposal boundary is now exact-source bound and rejects stale source apply evidence.
Recovery repair proposals must target the same normalized workspace-relative path as the failed source patch_file apply evidence.
Malformed, superseded, non-latest, blocked, multi-failure, or unrelated-path recovery evidence fails closed inside the Rust runtime.
Ledger evidence remains bounded to IDs, fingerprints, normalized source path, hunk counts, failure class, and replay state without raw content.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development by hardening the patch recovery primitive required before safe headless routing, with supporting controlled_workspace_tools, runtime_permission_enforcement, and persistent_structured_ledger.
answers.new_capability: Patch apply recovery admission and repair gating fail closed unless the source receipt is latest, strict, and exact-path linked to the generated recovery proposal.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M27.1 can admit stale source apply evidence and can treat an unrelated valid patch_file proposal as a successful recovery proposal.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: M27.2 headless routing would automate an unsafe recovery primitive that may recover the wrong file or stale failed apply.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M27.1 added recovery admission/proposal generation, M26.1 added multi-hunk patch apply, and M25.1 added single-hunk patch apply; this phase hardens exact-source correctness for existing recovery.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. Existing task.start/task.run recovery paths and existing proposal gate logic are hardened.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. No report, history, readiness, digest, preview, or inspection surface is added.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The runtime now rejects malformed receipts, superseded apply results, unrelated recovery proposal paths, and invalid hunk metadata before accepting recovery.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Prevents future headless.continue_once routing from driving stale or unrelated patch recovery evidence.
answers.milestone_progress: Removes a blocking correctness defect before M27.2 routing and M27 closeout can proceed.

review_value_gate.review_intent: M27.1.1 must be reviewed for exact source path binding, source receipt strictness, latest apply evidence enforcement, replay safety, and adversarial tests.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M27.1.1 changes the current phase manifest only; guard engine changes are not expected.

exit_criteria: patch_apply_recovery_source rejects missing, parent-traversal, or invalid source paths

patch_apply_recovery_source rejects receipts whose apply_status is not Denied, applied is not false, authorization_consumed is not false, blocked_checks is non-empty, failed_checks is not exactly one recoverable check, hunk_count is outside 1-5, or hunk_fingerprint is not sha256
patch_apply_recovery_source rejects a source apply result that is not the latest apply result for the same proposal
recovery-scoped patch proposals are marked only when their normalized proposal path matches the normalized source path
repair gate independently rejects unrelated-path or malformed-path recovery proposals
adversarial runtime tests cover unrelated path, superseded source apply, malformed receipts, normalized path acceptance, replay, and no workspace mutation
next_phase_candidate_notes: After M27.1.1 lands, resume M27.2 headless.continue_once routing across patch apply recovery admission/run boundaries without automatic apply.
